subject: NJ Democrat Candidate Rebecca Bennett Backs Bill that Study Says Would Crush 5 Million Jobs Nationwide, 60K in NJ
posts:
NJ candidate Rebecca Bennett backs a federal $25 minimum wage bill projected to cut 60K jobs in NJ and 5M nationwide.
Evidence: $25 wage push, EPI study job losses, national backlash
#Aletheia #USPol🌐

Proponents argue raising the federal minimum wage to $25 gives working families dignity against inflation.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.5) — Lesser Good

Studies show mandating a $25 wage destroys millions of entry-level jobs, hitting youth and small businesses hardest.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.7, -0.6) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Pursuing unviable wage mandates creates manufactured economic strain while harming the very workers promised relief.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 3.2, z: 2)

- Rebecca Bennett Campaign: FAIL (-0.6, -0.5) — Backs job-crushing mandates under wage dignity pretexts.

Rebecca Bennett, running in NJ's 7th District, champions the Living Wage For All Act, facing heavy pushback from Republicans over job losses.

The Poison:
Pitting worker dignity against economic viability creates destructive employment shocks for young workers.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing the noble goal of wage growth (Metaphysical) with a destructive legislative mechanism (Logical) that destroys 60K state jobs.

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors use a Smart Selfish Maneuver by framing economic intervention as altruistic protection while ignoring predictable employment destruction.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil through structural distortions.

The Unavoidable Truth: Well-intentioned wage mandates often destroy the entry-level jobs they aim to improve.
The Unavoidable Lie: Mandating a $25 wage has zero negative employment consequences.
